The video is haunting. Little Maryam,[ surrounded by fire and
smoke](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/14/israeli-air-strike-kills-
palestinian-woman-in-gaza-city), crying as she watches her mother burn.

Maryam Ghanem survived,[ rescued](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-strike-
kills-mother-leaves-gaza-girl-trapped-flames) by Palestinian journalist Ali
al-Jaafrawi. The toddler is now an orphan. Her father was killed just months
before she was born. She continues to ask for her mom.

Maryam herself will forever be haunted by a genocide that she was born into -
a genocide that took both of her parents and left her with severe burns. This
is the reality children like Maryam face every day as the world continues to
stand by as Israel kills, starves, burns.

Things didn't look any better in the occupied West Bank this week, where
settlers continued their pogroms on Palestinian villages and towns. On Friday,
settlers attacked Palestinian farmers during the olive harvest, injuring
several, including _Washington Post_ photojournalist Heidi Levine, an
American, in another incident caught on video.

How can the world continue to deny the horrors Palestinian endure every day
when such images continue to show up on our screens?
